title: Un nuevo mundo
goal: Read how the Soviet Union's dissolution ended the bipolar order and produced a "unipolar moment", and how the 1989 US invasion of Panama showed that force remained in play before later debates challenged this interpretation.
grammar: orden posterior a la Guerra Fría

items: State what happened to the Soviet Union.
Explain what the bipolar system gave way to.
Explain what the 1989 invasion of Panama showed about US force after the Soviet rivalry ended.
Describe what the unipolar interpretation later gave way to.
Use dar paso a to describe one reality replacing another.
